name: Barbell Box Squat
steps: Place a box behind you in a rack, at a height that puts thighs near parallel.
Rest the bar on your upper back, lift it off and step back to the box.
Set feet a little wider than shoulders.
Sit back with your hips until you are seated on the box, staying tight.
Pause briefly, then drive up through your heels to stand.
cues: Stay tight on the box, no relaxing
Breathe in and brace before each rep

common_mistakes.fix: Pause and sit softly before standing
Keep your stomach and back tight
